urls.title: Video URLs (urls)
urls.description: Paste one or more video URLs. Any site yt-dlp supports works - YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, Twitch, SoundCloud, Reddit, Dailymotion and 1000+ more. A playlist or channel URL expands into its videos (capped by Playlist limit).

includeFormats.title: All formats (includeFormats)
includeFormats.description: Return the full list of available formats (every resolution and codec with its direct URL), plus all thumbnail URLs. Turn off for a leaner result with only the best links.

includeSubtitles.title: Subtitles (includeSubtitles)
includeSubtitles.description: Include subtitle and auto-caption track URLs grouped by language.

playlistLimit.title: Videos per playlist (playlistLimit)
playlistLimit.description: Set how many videos to resolve at most from a playlist or channel URL. Keeps big channels from running long.
playlistLimit.sectionDescription: Optional settings for proxies, auth cookies, and large collections.

proxyConfiguration.title: IP routing (proxyConfiguration)
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Route requests through a proxy. Useful for sites that block datacenter IPs (TikTok, Instagram, X) - use a residential group there.

cookies.title: Login cookies (cookies)
cookies.description: Optional Netscape-format cookie file contents, for age-restricted or login-gated videos. Leave blank for public videos.
